sql: with f as (select o.id, o.status, o.strategy, (select t.contracts_ahead from live_order_queue_ticks t where t.live_order_id=o.id and t.contracts_ahead is not null order by t.captured_at limit 1) ahead from live_orders o where o.kalshi_order_id is not null and o.created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-16 11:00:00+00') select case when ahead is null then 'z_no_reading' when ahead=0 then 'a_front(0)' when ahead<=50 then 'b_1-50' when ahead<=500 then 'c_51-500' when ahead<=5000 then 'd_501-5000' else 'e_5000+' end bucket, count(*)::text orders, count(*) filter (where status='filled')::text filled, count(*) filter (where status='canceled')::text canceled, count(*) filter (where status in ('resting','partial','submitted'))::text open, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/nullif(count(*),0))::text fill_pct from f group by 1 order by 1
